description: Minimalist, photo-first cloud gallery with a Pinterest-style masonry layout. The UI should be almost invisible, letting the user's photos stand out.

layout.spacing: Generous outer padding (p-8 to p-12), tight inner gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layout.masonry: Use Tailwind CSS columns for masonry: `columns-1 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3 xl:columns-4 gap-6 space-y-6`. Use `break-inside-avoid` on child items to prevent images from splitting across columns.
layout.upload_zone: Large drag-and-drop area with dashed border (`border-2 border-dashed border-neutral-300`), rounded-xl, background `bg-neutral-50 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors`.

components.cards: Cardless design for the photos. The image itself is the card, rounded-lg with subtle hover effect.
components.buttons: High contrast black buttons (`bg-neutral-900 text-white hover:bg-neutral-800`) or outlined variants. Rounded-md.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for photo preview/metadata. Crystal glass background overlay (`bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl`) for the modal backdrop.
components.thumbnails: Optimized images filling the container. `w-full h-auto object-cover rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1`.
components.navigation: Minimal top nav, sticky with glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70`), containing Logo, Upload CTA, and User Profile.

interactions.hover: Subtle translation (`-translate-y-1`), slight shadow increase, or a very gentle scale (`scale-[1.02]`) on photos.
interactions.loading: Skeleton loaders matching the masonry shape for lazy loading.
interactions.drag_drop: Active state for drag zone should highlight prominently (e.g., solid border or tinted background).

instructions_to_main_agent: Include Google Fonts for 'Outfit' and 'Figtree' in public/index.html.
Use Tailwind CSS columns utility for the masonry layout (`columns-1 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3 xl:columns-4 space-y-6`). Do not use any third party masonry library unless absolutely necessary.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
Use Shadcn Dialog for image detail view and metadata.
Use standard HTML5 drag and drop API or a lightweight wrapper for the upload zone.
Prioritize optical alignment and generous spacing. Make the app feel airy and uncluttered.
The layout must be responsive, defaulting to 1 column on mobile.
